title: I-Echo evela kwiMda yeSixeko
intro: Kwisixeko esasifulathele ulwalathiso lukaThixo, kwavela umntu oyedwa ngaphandle, ebaleka nesigidimi sethemba nesilumkiso. Lo mphefumlo ulibalekileyo wawuya kuba luphawu olungunaphakade lokholo oluqinileyo.
clues: Ndibone abathunywa bethunyelwa kwisixeko sam, kodwa abantu bam babengabamkeli njengabantu abaqhelekileyo.
Ndandikholelwa kwisigidimi sabo kwaye ndaziva inyaniso ivakala ngaphakathi kum.
Ndibize abantu bam ukuba bathobele abathunywa abangacelanga mvuzo.
Ndabaleka ndisuka kweyona ndawo ikude yesixeko, ndizama ngamandla ukubanceda babone isizathu.
Abantu bam bandivukela, ndaza ndabulawa, kodwa ndafumana uxolo olungunaphakade.
U-Allah wathi kum, 'Ngena eParadesi,' kwaye ndinqwenela ukuba abantu bam babe nokubona imbeko endinikwe yona.
arabic: قِيلَ ٱدْخُلِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ ۖ قَالَ يَـٰلَيْتَ قَوْمِى يَعْلَمُونَ
verse: It was said, "Enter Paradise." He said, "I wish my people could know (36:26)
